analysis:
Two changes, no concrete security regression found.

1) docs/reference/qwen4-next-support.md: the date moves to 2026-10-20, and lines 79-82 now say every concrete Qwen3.8-27B build (ModelRuntimeRequirements.qwen38ConcreteModelIDs) shares the reasoning-effort validation boundary. This is documentation only. It adds no endpoint, key, attestation or cache behavior, and it doesn't touch T-041 or any TB-011 policy. The claim depends on Qwen4SupportPolicy.validateReasoningContext, which is not in this batch and was not checked.

2) MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine.swift, patch hunk at ~731, one added line: `if let engineError = error as? MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngineError { throw engineError }`. In that catch block it now rethrows typed scheduler errors unchanged, ahead of the EngineV2VisionPrefillError mapping. Previously these errors may have been wrapped or reclassified by code that is not visible. Only base lines 1-530 were supplied, and the changed region near line 731 is covered by the patch hunk alone. I could not see the surrounding catch block or which error cases are thrown there.

The next pass should confirm two things:
(a) Error cases such as invalidToolPayload(String) or the scheduler-message parser output carry no prompt text, tool schema content or internal paths. ProviderLoop+ErrorMapping.swift (sanitizedInferenceFailure) must still bound them before they reach the coordinator or consumer. This matters for A-001 and TB-002 and is also relevant to T-008.
(b) The earlier reservation and lease release (releaseBox.fire / native lease unwind) still runs on this path. The surrounding vision-prefill code is not visible, so neither point could be checked here.

No T-041 prefix-cache surface is touched.
